text: Too terrified to cry out, he tried to speak his dead wifes name and to reach across the table, but his throat was powerless. <break time="0.8s" /> Then something heavy was hurled against the table, pushing its edge against his chest, and fell to the floor with a thump that shook the whole house. <break time="0.8s" /> There followed a scuffling and a confusion of sounds impossible to describe, and when he groped for the table in the darkness, nothing was there. <break time="0.8s" /> Half mad with terror, he seized the loaded rifle that leaned against the wall and fired it into the dark without aiming at anything. <break time="0.8s" /> By the bright flash he saw an enormous panther dragging the body of his wife toward the window, and then everything went black and silent again. <break time="0.8s" /> When he came to his senses, the sun was high, and the forest outside was full of the cheerful songs of birds. <break time="0.8s" /> The body lay near the window where the beast had left it, its clothing torn and its long hair in disorder, and the ribbon around its wrists was broken. <break time="0.8s" /> Her hands, which had been tied gently together the night before, were now tightly clenched, and between her teeth was a fragment of the animals ear.
